free_launch.description: When true (or ASTRO_FREE_LAUNCH_ENTITLE_ALL=1), every authenticated user is treated as fully entitled. Set false after paid launch.

notes: OWNER INPUT REQUIRED: plan names (name / display_name_*), which features are premium (feature_catalog.*.premium true|false), free-tier daily_limits numbers, store product IDs, and provider (revenuecat | native).
null daily_limits fall back to ASTRO_DAILY_* env vars (or built-in defaults) until the owner sets numbers.
null feature premium means the gate is inactive until the owner marks the feature true or false.
Prices must never be stored here; they come from the store at runtime.
